AI suggestions are for general information and education only. They are not medical diagnosis, treatment, or a substitute for a doctor or registered dietitian. If you have a medical condition, are pregnant or breastfeeding, have a history of an eating disorder, food allergy, or prescribed diet, consult a qualified health professional before following dietary advice. The app must not replace your clinician's instructions or recommend changing medication.
Personalized meal plans and nutrition guidance are being prepared. No diet or medical advice will be shown before the safety notice is acknowledged.
Nutrition guidance will be based on reputable public-health sources and clearly identified estimates.
Create an adult profile to get an educational meal-plan example based on your goal and activity level.
I have a medical condition / prescribed diet / pregnancy / eating-disorder history
For safety, this prototype cannot generate a personalized diet when a medical condition or special clinical circumstance is selected. Please consult your doctor or registered dietitian.
Enter age, height and weight using numbers.
This planner is designed only for adults aged 18–75. Check that height and weight are entered in cm and kg.
These are rough screening estimates, not measurements or a prescription. Individual needs can differ substantially.

Grilled chicken, a moderate serving of rice, salad and plain yogurt.
One seasonal fruit and a small handful of unsalted nuts.
Lentil soup or bean stew with whole-grain bread and vegetables.
Whole-wheat bread, cheese, walnuts, cucumber and tomato.
Bean and vegetable stew, a moderate serving of rice and salad.
Lentil soup with whole-grain bread, yogurt and vegetables.

This is a general example, not a medically tailored prescription. Adjust portions to hunger, culture, budget and professional advice. Choose varied minimally processed foods and limit excess salt, free sugars and unhealthy fats.
Your BMI is outside the usual adult screening range. BMI alone cannot assess health; seek professional advice before pursuing weight change.
For a weight-loss goal, avoid crash diets or skipping meals. Keep portions comfortable, include vegetables and protein-rich foods, and review progress gradually with a professional if unsure.
For a weight-gain goal, consider an additional nourishing snack such as yogurt with oats or a peanut-butter sandwich. Avoid relying on sugary drinks or ultra-processed foods.
Your BMI estimate is outside this prototype’s screening range. It will not suggest a weight-change plan; please discuss your goal with a qualified professional.
